cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. That innocent cup started the argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.

mechanism: A coaches its former writing pupil to blame a supposedly harmless cup for the ruined letter while avoiding A tipping and holding it.
confusable: Not a straightforward spill apology: every new piece of evidence about A is redirected to the same cup detail.
comparison: Decoration on support rope versus vessel near correspondence.
